page.layout: Title "INDEX." at top, centred. Below it, two columns of index entries with page numbers at their right ends: the left column first, then the right column. Letter headings (L, M, N) sit within the columns. The last line of the right column, "Nico", is cut off at the bottom of the scan.
page.head: INDEX.
page.notes: The last line "Nico" is cut off at the bottom of the right column; only the first letters are visible, so the rest is unknown. The "I" of the initial letters in the first entries is read as I/J as printed. The printed "Ioânes" has a mark over the a that I read as a circumflex; this is uncertain.
